instruction: You are given two input files `/home/user/Desktop/job_baseline.py` and `/home/user/Desktop/job_yaw.py`. Complete automated multi-job management and comparison reporting from the command line: 1. Write automation script `/home/user/Desktop/run_pipeline.py` (or shell script): - Run `job_baseline` and `job_yaw` in serial - Monitor completion by checking generated output files 2. Write post-processing script `/home/user/Desktop/compare.py`: - Read both results - Extract total power and downstream power for each job - Compute gain percentages 3. Generate comparison report `/home/user/Desktop/comparison_report.txt` in this format: `Job, Total_Power_kw, Downstream_Power_kw` `baseline, xx, xx` `yaw, xx, xx` `Gain_Total_Percent, xx` `Gain_Downstream_Percent, xx` 4. Do not use any GUI.
